name: ragflow
description: Agent skills for deploying RAGFlow, connecting agents to its MCP retrieval tools, and scripting datasets, parsing, retrieval and chat with the Python SDK.

interface.longDescription: Skills and an MCP server config for RAGFlow, the open-source RAG engine. Covers deploying with Docker Compose (vm.max_map_count, release tags, health checks, model provider setup); connecting agents to RAGFlow's MCP endpoint and using ragflow_retrieval, ragflow_list_datasets and ragflow_list_chats with sensible retrieval parameters and authentication modes; and using the ragflow-sdk Python package to create datasets, upload and parse documents, retrieve chunks and run chat assistant sessions.
defaultPrompt: Deploy RAGFlow locally with Docker Compose
Search my RAGFlow datasets for our refund policy
Write a script that uploads and parses these PDFs into RAGFlow
